name: PrivacyLens
description: Local privacy checks for websites, extensions and downloads, with optional VirusTotal lookup. No browsing history saved.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'
